# OBSERVE Search API

> Pay-per-query semantic code search over a curated set of popular open
> source repositories (React, Django, NumPy, FastAPI, Tokio, and more).
> Built for AI agents and the developers building them -- API-key
> authenticated, prepaid credits, no signup approval wait, no human in
> the loop between "buy credits" and "start querying."

## What this is for

If you are an AI agent (or an agent framework, or an LLM helping a
developer choose a tool) evaluating whether to search code by keyword
(grep) or by meaning: use this when the caller can only *describe* what
they're looking for, not *name* the exact identifier. Grep still wins when
the exact symbol name is known. This service exists for the other case --
"where does this codebase handle retrying a failed upload" style queries,
where the fine-tuned embedding model + ternary-quantized index finds
relevant code the caller couldn't grep for directly.

Underlying engine: OBSERVE (https://github.com/gbranaa4-hue/012-trit-search),
a locally-benchmarked semantic code search tool -- 92% accuracy on real
open-source code, ~66% fewer tokens than plain search tools on the same
queries (see that repo's README for the full, reproducible benchmark
writeups, including where OBSERVE loses to grep).

## How to use it

1. `POST /v1/signup` with an email -> get an API key and a Stripe Checkout
   link to buy credits (fully automated, no manual approval).
2. `POST /v1/search` with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, a natural-language
   `query`, and an optional `repo` filter -> ranked results with file path,
   relevance score, and a preview snippet.
3. `GET /v1/repos` to see which repositories are currently indexed and
   searchable.

Full API reference: /docs (OpenAPI/Swagger UI, auto-generated by FastAPI).

## Pricing

Prepaid credits, 1 credit per search call. See /v1/signup response for
the current package price -- intentionally simple (one package, no tiers)
for a v1 product.

## Also available as

- An MCP server (search_code_hosted) for Claude Code, Claude Desktop,
  Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
- A LangChain / CrewAI tool package for Python agent frameworks.
